items.name: Finset.prod_antidiagonal_pow_choose_succ
items.type: {M : Type u_2} [CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) : ∏ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (n + 1), f ij.1 ij.2 ^ (n + 1).choose ij.1 = (∏ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, f ij.1 (ij.2 + 1) ^ n.choose ij.1) * ∏ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, f (ij.1 + 1) ij.2 ^ n.choose ij.2

items.name: Finset.prod_pow_choose_succ
items.type: {M : Type u_2} [CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) : ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), f i (n + 1 - i) ^ (n + 1).choose i = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f i (n + 1 - i) ^ n.choose i) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f (i + 1) (n - i) ^ n.choose i

items.name: Nat.prod_pow_factorization_choose
items.type: (n k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n) : ∏ p ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), p ^ (n.choose k).factorization p = n.choose k

items.name: Finset.prod_powersetCard
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [CommMonoid β] (n : ℕ) (s : Finset α) (f : ℕ → β) : ∏ t ∈ Finset.powersetCard n s, f t.card = f n ^ s.card.choose n

items.name: Nat.uniformBell_eq
items.type: (m n : ℕ) : m.uniformBell n = ∏ p ∈ Finset.range m, (p * n + n - 1).choose (n - 1)

items.name: Choose.choose_modEq_prod_range_choose_nat
items.type: {n k p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ} (ha₁ : n < p ^ a) (ha₂ : k < p ^ a) : n.choose k ≡ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range a, (n / p ^ i % p).choose (k / p ^ i % p) [MOD p]

items.type: {n k p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ} (ha₁ : n < p ^ a) (ha₂ : k < p ^ a) : n.choose k ≡ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range a, (n / p ^ i % p).choose (k / p ^ i % p) [MOD p]

items.name: Choose.choose_modEq_prod_range_choose
items.type: {n k p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ} (ha₁ : n < p ^ a) (ha₂ : k < p ^ a) : ↑(n.choose k) ≡ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range a, ↑((n / p ^ i % p).choose (k / p ^ i % p)) [ZMOD ↑p]

items.type: {n k p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : ℕ) : ↑(n.choose k) ≡ ↑((n / p ^ a).choose (k / p ^ a)) * ↑(∏ i ∈ Finset.range a, (n / p ^ i % p).choose (k / p ^ i % p)) [ZMOD ↑p]
